    ## [How do solo founders stay consistent on Instagram, LinkedIn and email without burning out?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/how-do-solo-founders-stay-consistent-on-social-media-without-burning-out/)

    Make one core idea, then let it turn into everything else. A single voice note or short idea becomes a caption, a LinkedIn post and a newsletter paragraph through a connected process. You create once and the pieces are drafted for you, so consistency stops depending on how much energy you have that day.

-   [How do I plan a month of Instagram posts in one sitting?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/how-do-i-plan-a-month-of-instagram-posts-in-one-sitting/)

    content

    ## [How do I plan a month of Instagram posts in one sitting?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/how-do-i-plan-a-month-of-instagram-posts-in-one-sitting/)

    Pick four lessons you already teach, one for each week. Give each week one job: a problem, a how-to, a real story, and an offer. Turn each lesson into a few posts with a hook and a call to action, then queue the whole month in one sitting.

    19 October 2026 · 3 min read

-   [How do I turn one idea into a week of posts?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/how-do-i-turn-one-idea-into-a-week-of-posts/)

    content

    ## [How do I turn one idea into a week of posts?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/how-do-i-turn-one-idea-into-a-week-of-posts/)

    Start with one lesson you already teach, in three to six sentences. Give it to an AI tool with your voice and a rule not to invent anything, and ask for one newsletter, three short captions and three hooks. Edit them, add one real example, and spread them across your week.

    9 October 2026 · 3 min read

-   [Why does everything I write with AI sound like AI?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/why-does-everything-i-write-with-ai-sound-like-ai/)

    ai writing

    ## [Why does everything I write with AI sound like AI?](https://www.theautomatestack.com/blog/why-does-everything-i-write-with-ai-sound-like-ai/)

    Because AI can only reshape what you give it. Give it a thin idea and it hands back a thin, generic post. Feed it your own words, your own example and a few plain rules, then edit what comes back before you post.

    8 October 2026 · 4 min read
